<!-- ABOUTME: Help documentation for the WaveSpeed Save Audio ComfyUI node. -->
<!-- ABOUTME: Downloads and saves audio files generated by WaveSpeed AI. -->

# WaveSpeed Save Audio

Downloads an audio file from a URL and saves it to the ComfyUI output directory.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|-----------|------|---------|-------------|
| audio_url | String | -- | URL of the audio to download and save |
| save_file_prefix | String | "wavespeed_audio" | Prefix for the saved audio filename |

## Output

| Output | Type | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| file_path | String | Local file path where the audio was saved |

## Notes

- Defaults to `.mp3` extension if the URL doesn't contain a recognizable audio extension
- This is an output node -- it can terminate a workflow branch
